## Overview
Systems and Platform Product Manager specializing in live-service game economy, LiveOps, and player progression systems.
- Proven metrics: 0-to-1 platform launch, +15% conversion, -40% transmission failure rates.
- Certified Game Economy Designer (Machinations.io).
- Warframe: Legendary Rank 1 at 938 tracked hours, Star Chart 238/238, Steel Path 238/238, 6,483 missions.

## Strategic Deep Dives & Economy Teardowns
- [Warframe: The Venus Gate](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/venus-gate/): Game economy analysis and Machinations modeling of Warframe's early progression drop curve, Fossa Jackal assassination runs, and the Plastids crafting gate.
- [Publish the Bill Before the Grind](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/binding-constraint/): Product brief on surfacing the binding constraint in crafting economics and player transparency.
- [Warframe: Tau](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/tau-readiness/): A launch-readiness read. Pre-launch instrumentation plan for Tau (Fornax and Brysko): day-one telemetry, Bloom economy guardrails, infrastructure provisioning, and paired north-star / counter-metrics. Written 13 July 2026, before launch.
- [Warframe: Iceblade of Narin](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/fall-bridge/): Making the fall bridge hold. Pre-launch retention plan for Warframe's fall 2026 update: Banshee rework adoption at D14, Prime Access purchase versus use, power-creep and meta-concentration guardrails, one-lane rollback. Written 16 July 2026, before launch.
- [Warframe: Forecast Scorecard](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/forecast-scorecard/): A live-ops forecast, graded after launch. A pre-launch read of Warframe's August 2026 live-ops beat (Amir's Shockwave), written 13 July 2026, locked, and graded against the shipped patch on 14 August: three of four spine-level claims missed, each named, with the original forecast kept unedited on the page. Published 11 September 2026.
- [Where a match-3 asks you to pay: 52 levels, logged by hand](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/offer-explorer/): Where a match-3 asks you to pay: 52 levels, logged by hand. A first-hand mobile free-to-play teardown of Match Factory! - coin balance by level, offer timing and prices from one logged session, with a live tool that reads the play log. The call: gate the first priced offer on a measured need state rather than a level number. Independent analysis, published 23 September 2026.
- [Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)](https://adwaith-mrv.github.io/nfs-most-wanted/): Progression loop design, loss-aversion friction buffers, and live telemetry balancing teardown.
